# Reference design for Autocomplete and Search Suggestion Engine

## Architecture
Use a trie node with a character-to-child map and terminal word metadata. Keep normalization and ranking policy separate from trie structure.

## Algorithm/design sketch
Reference pseudocode: walk/create nodes for every character; mark terminal; on query walk prefix then DFS candidates and rank by frequency. Bound result count and test empty prefix.

## Complexity targets
Insert/search O(L) for word length L; enumerating suggestions costs proportional to visited nodes and returned results.

## Reference code excerpt
```python
class CircularQueue:
    def __init__(self, capacity):
        if capacity <= 0: raise ValueError("capacity must be positive")
        self.data = [None] * capacity; self.head = 0; self.size = 0
    def enqueue(self, item):
        if self.size == len(self.data): raise OverflowError("queue full")
        tail = (self.head + self.size) % len(self.data)
        self.data[tail] = item; self.size += 1
    def dequeue(self):
        if self.size == 0: raise IndexError("queue empty")
        item = self.data[self.head]; self.data[self.head] = None
        self.head = (self.head + 1) % len(self.data); self.size -= 1
        return item

q = CircularQueue(2); q.enqueue("A"); q.enqueue("B")
assert q.dequeue() == "A"; q.enqueue("C"); assert q.dequeue() == "B"
```

## Validation checklist
- Define observable behavior, input constraints and error handling.
- Verify a normal case, boundary case, invalid case and adversarial case.
- Compare output against a simple baseline implementation.
- Record the Python/runtime version and exact test command.
- Keep all user submission execution outside the CodeLeaf API process; this file is a blueprint and example excerpt, not a complete deployable application.
